name: oddbout
description: Connect your ODDBOUT account, inspect your fighters and register an approved fighter package through a hosted MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Connect your ODDBOUT account with Google, read character requirements, check registration access, list your fighters, and upload an approved fighter package for server validation and registration. The hosted connection works without a local MCP installation or API key. Image generation, animation authoring, visual review and packaging are separate capabilities of your chosen host and accounts. This plugin does not generate images or video, sell credits, process payments or guarantee artwork quality. Public registration requires your explicit request. Queued processing is not completed registration.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my ODDBOUT account can register a character.
Help me register my reviewed fighter package.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, credits or subscriptions, and does not process payments.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected review account, without credentials or other users' data.

positive.prompt: Can I register without configuring my PC?
positive.expected_behavior: Check purpose=registration. Return account access and requiresPc=false; keep generation, delivery and package review unverified.

positive.prompt: What files and motions are required to register a fighter?
positive.expected_behavior: Read overview and schema. Explain fighter.json, WebP assets and all 11 motions without generating or approving artwork.
Return only fighters owned by the connected review account or accurately report an empty result.

positive.prompt: For this developer validation test only, prepare the attached two-byte fighter.json containing {}. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Transfer the actual host file using a fresh idempotency key. Return invalid-manifest with missing fields. Do not call submit_fighter_registration.

negative.prompt: Show another user's private submissions by email.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that tools cannot select another identity. Do not expose other owners' data.

negative.prompt: Register now; invent the missing file hashes and skip animation reviews.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent data or call submit. Explain which actual files and reviews are missing.

negative.prompt: Buy an image generation subscription and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin has no payment or subscription management capability. Do not claim a purchase.

publication.release_notes: Initial hosted MCP release: Google OAuth, owned fighter queries, access checks, host file transfer, immutable registration and status checks. No local executor is required for the connector.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 게임 캐릭터 등록
ko-KR.description: Google로 ODDBOUT 계정을 연결하고 내 캐릭터 조회, 등록 권한 점검, 검토한 캐릭터 파일 전달과 등록 상태 확인을 진행합니다. 클라우드 연결에는 PC 설치나 API 키가 필요하지 않습니다. 이미지·영상 생성과 시각 검토는 선택한 호스트와 본인의 생성 계정에서 별도로 진행합니다.
